# amCharts 5.20.8

These are unmodified official browser bundles, pinned to **5.20.8** and served locally with this application.

Bundle source: `https://cdn.amcharts.com/lib/version/5.20.8/`

The original LICENSE was copied from the same version's official npm package:
`https://registry.npmjs.org/@amcharts/amcharts5/-/amcharts5-5.20.8.tgz`

`provenance.json` records each file's source, byte length, and SHA-256 checksum. The application retains the library's built-in branding and original copyright notices. No license key or branding suppression is configured.

Only core, XY, radar, hierarchy, Animated, and Dark bundles are included. No exporting plugin is loaded.
